'''Giulio Benedetto Isacco Vivanti''' (24 May 1859 – 19 November 1949) was an [[Italian Jews|Italian Jewish]] [[mathematician]]. He was a mentor of [[Bruno de Finetti]] and he spent most of his academic career at the [[University of Pavia]] and [[University of Milan]].
